notes.title: New languages on board!
notes.content:

[list]
[*] Portuguese-Brazilian 
[*] German
[*] Spanish
[*] French 
[*] Chinese-Simplified
[/list]

And dearest gamers, fans and translators who made it possible:

For Portuguese-Brazilian:[url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/veronnicarj/]Veronnica78[/url], [url=http://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198221610176/]ricknya[/url],

And others.
